categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, production, testing, and sales of power semiconductor devices and power electronic equipment. Its product portfolio includes high-voltage large-power semiconductor devices, ultra-large power chemical power supply equipment, and testing and non-standard equipment. These products serve key sectors such as ultra-high voltage DC transmission, new energy grid integration, metallurgy, and industrial power control.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary technologies including high-voltage thyristor full-pressure contact technology, low-temperature welding, and terminal structure design. It independently designs and manufactures core components, emphasizing ISO9001 quality management and advanced statistical process control methods like Six Sigma and SPC. The company also develops new power devices such as IGCT and FRD through continuous R&D efforts.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major national energy projects like State Grid Corporation and China Southern Power Grid, as well as leading enterprises in power equipment and industrial sectors. The company’s products are widely used in ultra-high voltage DC transmission projects, new energy integration, metallurgy, rail transit, and other industrial applications. The top five customers account for approximately 86% of sales, indicating a concentrated but stable customer base.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with domestic sales accounting for over 99% of revenue. It has begun expanding into international markets including South America, the Middle East, and Africa, leveraging China's technological and engineering advantages in ultra-high voltage transmission projects abroad. The headquarters and main production facilities are located in Xi'an High-tech Zone, Shaanxi Province.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the power semiconductor supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and assembly of power semiconductor devices and related power electronic equipment. It procures raw materials and components but independently controls core technology and production processes, ensuring product quality and technological security.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous technological innovation in power semiconductor devices, especially IGCT, FRD, and IGBT products, and expanding market applications for power electronic equipment. The company emphasizes product structure optimization, technology upgrades, market expansion, supply chain collaboration, platform development, and digital transformation. Talent acquisition and sustainable development are also key focus areas.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of self-produced power semiconductor devices and power electronic equipment. The company mainly uses a direct sales model, especially for high-voltage large-power devices used in national energy projects, supplemented by bidding and tendering processes. It also earns income from investment returns and government subsidies related to R&D and innovation.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in high-voltage, large-power, and ultra-large-power power semiconductor devices, particularly in high-grade thyristors. It benefits from its heritage linked to Xi'an Electric Power Electronics Research Institute and strong government backing. Its competitive advantages include proprietary technology, quality management, brand reputation, and stable high-end customer relationships, positioning it as an industry leader in China.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 191.8 million, a 64.14% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 56.8 million, up 157.84%. Total assets reached about RMB 988.7 million, with a net asset increase of 5.73%. The company has shown strong revenue and profit growth driven by market expansion and product innovation, despite some fluctuations in cash flow.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its advanced proprietary technologies, high product quality, and reliability tailored for ultra-high voltage DC transmission and new energy integration. Its products feature high consistency and long-term operational reliability, critical for national energy infrastructure. The company also offers comprehensive pre-sales and after-sales technical support, fostering strong customer trust and brand recognition as a symbol of high-end quality in power semiconductor devices.
